items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Terminology 48:1
items.html: The four levels that emerge through the coupling by striking at the time of the refining of the screen are called “Nekudot,” and they are called reflected light, since they are judgement. (Part 4, Chapter 3, Item 11)
